summary: All 11 features tested successfully. Admin Coupons and Tax Rates pages have full CRUD functionality working. Audit Logs page displays IP address and User Agent, with Export to CSV/JSON working. Backend APIs verified via pytest (17/17 tests passed).
passed_tests: Admin Coupons page - view coupons list at /admin/coupons with SAVE20 coupon displayed
Admin Coupons page - 'Create Coupon' button opens dialog with full form (code, discount type, value, description, max uses, valid until, active toggle)
Admin Coupons page - Edit coupon via 3-dot action menu
Admin Coupons page - Delete coupon via 3-dot action menu
Admin Tax Rates page - view tax rates list at /admin/tax-rates with US Sales Tax (8.25%) displayed
Admin Tax Rates page - 'Add Tax Rate' button opens dialog with full form (name, rate, country, state, description, tax inclusive, active toggle)
Admin Tax Rates page - Edit tax rate via 3-dot action menu
Admin Tax Rates page - Delete tax rate via 3-dot action menu
Audit Logs page - Export dropdown shows 'Export as CSV' and 'Export as JSON' options
Audit Logs page - CSV export downloads file with ip_address and user_agent columns
Audit Logs page - JSON export downloads file with ip_address and user_agent fields
Audit Logs page - Displays IP address (e.g., 104.198.214.223) in activity log entries
Audit Logs page - Displays User Agent (e.g., python-requests/2.32.5) in activity log entries
Backend API - GET /api/admin/coupons returns coupon list
Backend API - POST /api/admin/coupons creates coupon
Backend API - PUT /api/admin/coupons/{code} updates coupon
Backend API - DELETE /api/admin/coupons/{code} deletes coupon
Backend API - GET /api/admin/tax-rates returns tax rate list
Backend API - POST /api/admin/tax-rates creates tax rate
Backend API - PUT /api/admin/tax-rates/{id} updates tax rate
Backend API - DELETE /api/admin/tax-rates/{id} deletes tax rate
Backend API - GET /api/admin/audit-logs/export?format=csv exports CSV
Backend API - GET /api/admin/audit-logs/export?format=json exports JSON
critical_code_review_comments: AdminCouponsPage.jsx: Well-structured CRUD with stats cards, search filter, status filter, and responsive dialog forms
AdminTaxRatesPage.jsx: Clean implementation with country dropdown, tax inclusive toggle, and location display with state badges
AdminAuditLogsPage.jsx: Export dropdown correctly triggers CSV/JSON download, IP address and User Agent displayed with icons (Globe and Monitor)
Backend server.py: Coupons API uses coupon code as identifier for updates/deletes, Tax Rates use UUID-based IDs
Backend server.py: log_audit_event helper captures ip_address and user_agent from request headers via get_client_ip() and get_user_agent()
seed_data_creation: Test coupon 'SAVE20' (20% off) and tax rate 'US Sales Tax' (8.25% for US-CA) created by main agent
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Coupons page at /admin/coupons shows coupon list with CRUD operations. Admin Tax Rates page at /admin/tax-rates shows tax rates with CRUD operations. Audit Logs page at /admin/audit-logs shows activity log with IP address and User Agent displayed for each entry, and Export dropdown to download CSV or JSON files. All backend APIs for coupons, tax rates, and audit log export are fully functional.
